description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'Field' for migrating field configuration data from the database, including methods for querying data, defining fields, preparing rows, and specifying IDs.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: A migration source plugin class for extracting Drupal 7 field configuration data from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to retrieve active, non-deleted field configurations, excluding title module fields if the title module is enabled.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the source data, with labels.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row by unserializing the 'data' property into key-value pairs and fetching related field instances.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifiers for the source data, 'field_name' and 'entity_type'.
